items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Mud Kerrie had went with Ory, back with Kid Ory's band.

ctx.x: George Few Clothes Place. So Buddy Petit had joined the tuxedo band with Celestan, then went out to the suburban garden. So I goes out to George Few Clothes in the district and work for, and work where Buddy Petit was playing with Jimmy Noon and that bunch. So, that time, there was coming drafting and drafting for the World War I. Registration was coming around. And the guy was looking for, that didn't register for the war, didn't register to go to war. And the guy asked me, say, let me see your registration…
You heard of that band? Yeah, they still have one.
